Please quote FOB Ningbo by air, we need goods in 20 days. Payment: we usually pay 100% 60 days after delivery. Best, Mark (purchasing@example-kitchen.com)

content:
{"reply": "Hi Mark,

Thank you for your inquiry about our 1.7L Stainless Steel Electric Kettle (model KET-17S). I'm glad to support your Amazon business in Texas. Here are our product details, quote, and some important points before you decide.

1. Certification and material (please read first)
- UL / ETL: We do not currently hold UL or ETL listing for this model. Our current certifications are a CB report (IEC 60335-2-15) and CE (LVD/EMC). If UL listing is a firm requirement for your US sales channel, I don't want you to place an order based on a wrong assumption. Please let me know how you'd like to proceed.
- BPA: The water-contact inner body is 304 stainless steel, and the lid and handle are PP plastic. However, we do not have a BPA test report, so we cannot provide documentation to support a "BPA free" claim at this time.

2. Product highlights
- 1.7L capacity, 1500W, 120V 60Hz (US version)
- 304 stainless steel inner body
- Auto shut-off and boil-dry protection
- 360° swivel base
- Concealed heating element for easy cleaning
- Boils 1.7L in about 5 minutes (based on our internal factory test, not a third-party report)

3. Price
- 1,200 pcs: USD 9.80 per unit, FOB Ningbo, by sea
- For reference: 2,000 to 4,999 pcs at USD 9.20 per unit; 5,000+ pcs at USD 8.70 per unit
- MOQ: 500 pcs, so your 1,200 pcs first order is no problem.
- Packaging: color box, 6 units per carton

4. Your logo on the box
Since your order is over 1,000 pcs, printing your logo on the color box is free of charge. We just need your logo in vector format (AI, EPS, or PDF).

5. Lead time
Our standard production lead time is 35 days after we receive the deposit and approve the artwork. We cannot meet a 20-day delivery. FOB is a sea-freight term, so our quote is based on shipment from Ningbo-Zhoushan port. If you prefer air freight, your forwarder can arrange it, but the 35-day production time still applies.

6. Payment terms
We are unable to accept 100% payment 60 days after delivery. We can offer either of these options:
- 30% T/T deposit, with the 70% balance paid against a copy of the B/L
- L/C at sight

7. Ways to check our quality and factory
- Samples: We charge samples at the ex-factory unit price, and you cover the international shipping. The sample cost will be deducted from your bulk order.
- Video factory tour: We can arrange a live video call through Alibaba to show you our production line.

If the certification status and terms above work for you, I'd suggest starting with a sample so you can check the quality yourself. Just send me your logo file and shipping details and I'll prepare a formal PI right away. If UL listing is essential, please let me know and we can discuss what is possible.

Looking forward to your reply.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Sales Representative
Yongjiang Small Appliances
Ningbo, China"}
